6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for God as the CREATION: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP2 learner study God as the CREATION?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

1. What does God b) Sing simple songs on God identify things that God provide for us?

1. Know what God as the CREATION means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify God as a healer for of God as the provider and 4..
